name: Maintenance computer
what it is: The chief engineer's computer, on the desk in the day room: a screen on its stand, a keyboard, a mouse, and the system unit on the deck under the desk's after end. On it runs Maintenance Desk, a Johansson Co program: every item aboard with its jobs, its records, its drawings and its instructions. **A tap on it sits one down at it**: the program fills the page, and one button, "Back to the Chisum", goes back aboard.

name: Twin socket outlet, chief engineer's desk
what it is: A twin 230 V socket on her side under the desk, 0.30 m over the deck, for the computer and its screen: circuit S1 of the suite's board DB-CE (16 A, 3 x 2.5 mm², in skirting trunking, as the owner's method statement MS-CE-001 has it). Its cable goes aft and inboard in the trunking to the place of DB-CE beside the door and **ends there in a box, marked**: the board is not installed.

name: Data outlet, chief engineer's desk
what it is: A network outlet beside the socket. Its cable goes in the same trunking to the same box and **ends there, marked**: no network cabinet is installed aboard, and no network is registered. The maintenance program keeps its records on the computer itself and needs none.

name: Place of distribution board DB-CE (not installed)
what it is: On the after wall beside the door: a yellow outline and a sign where the suite's distribution board is to stand, and under it the box in which the day room's two cables end. **Nothing is installed.** The skirting trunking from the desk's outlets comes along her side and the after wall and up to the box.

name: Desk, chief engineer's day room
what it is: A writing desk 1.60 m long and 0.75 m deep along her side at the room's after end, as the owner's drawing of the suite has it (CE-SUITE-GA-001: at the ship's side beside a window). A top on two end panels with a back panel between them, and a pedestal of three drawers at its forward end. Its forward half metre is under the window, 0.31 m under the sill.

name: Chair, chief engineer's desk
what it is: An office chair on a five-star base before the desk: whoever sits in it faces her side and the screen, with the window at the right hand.

name: Wall calendar, chief engineer's day room
what it is: A calendar on the after wall, open at November 2026 with the day ringed: "The engine room watch", three engineers in boiler suits in a manga's manner. The owner, 12 November 2026: "a calendar in the chief engineers office with cute manga ladies". Its picture was made with an image service from a description (blender/cabin_pictures.py says how); its month is drawn from the calendar itself.
